defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced but only 52 EACH received (8 kits damaged and refused at the dock)
rationale: Prices match the PO exactly (clause 3), but the goods receipt shows only 52 of 60 kits accepted, so the quantity dispute resolves in favour of the receipt (clause 4): 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00 net. Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% on the corrected net is $1,248.00, giving $17,888.00 gross; the supplier's $1,440.00 tax is simply a consequence of the over-invoiced quantity, so this is a single defect and clause 11 escalation is not triggered. No credit memos; $17,888.00 requires AP_MANAGER approval (clauses 9, 10).
